name: concurrent-last-unit-reservation
invariant: Of concurrent grants racing for the last unit of a resource group through the writer, exactly one is granted and the rest are refused quota_exhausted, reserving nothing; a release returns the unit, so a later grant is admitted and the next refused again (03 "The writer"; 05 "Lease"). The grants are the fixture's commands calling lease.ChangeLease, with capacity.Reservations composed after lease.Projector.
